title: Pythagoras Theorem and Converse — Triangles
hook: Let's explore Pythagoras Theorem and Converse from the chapter on Triangles. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Pythagoras Theorem and Converse In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the other two sides. The converse helps identify right triangles. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Pythagoras: In right △ABC with ∠B = 90°, AC² = AB² + BC²
💡 Hypotenuse is always the longest side (opposite the right angle)
💡 Converse: If AC² = AB² + BC², then ∠B = 90°
💡 Common Pythagorean triplets: (3,4,5), (5,12,13), (8,15,17), (7,24,25)
